en: n. an object shown in a museum or at an exhibition; a document shown in a court of law as evidence; vt. to show something publicly so that people can look at it; to show a particular quality; vi. to hold an exhibition
ex: The museum has a new exhibit on ancient Egypt.
博物館有一個關於古埃及的新展品。

en: vt. to make something bigger in size, number or amount; to explain something in more detail; vi. to become bigger; to talk about something in more detail
ex: The company plans to expand its business overseas.
公司計畫把業務擴展到海外。

en: n. the process of becoming larger in size or amount; the act of making something bigger; an increase in the size or scope of a business
ex: The rapid expansion of the city has caused traffic problems.
城市的快速擴張造成了交通問題。

en: a. relating to or used in scientific experiments; based on new ideas or methods that are being tested; not yet fully developed or proven
ex: The new drug is still at an experimental stage.
這種新藥仍處於實驗階段。

en: n. a statement or description that makes something easier to understand; the reasons given for something; a statement that gives the reason for something that has happened
ex: She gave a clear explanation of how the system works.
她清楚說明了系統的運作方式。

en: a. able to explode or likely to explode; likely to change suddenly in a violent way; (of a person) easily angered; n. a substance that can explode; a speech sound made by suddenly releasing air
ex: The situation in the region is highly explosive.
該地區的局勢一觸即發。

en: v. to make something longer or larger; to continue for a longer period of time; to offer something such as help or welcome; to cover a particular distance or area
ex: The company decided to extend the deadline by one week.
公司決定把期限延長一週。

en: n. the size or area of something; the degree to which something is true; the range of something; an area of land or water
ex: We don't yet know the full extent of the damage.
我們尚不清楚損害的全貌。

en: n. a building or place used for a particular purpose; (plural) equipment or services that make something possible; the ability to do something easily and well; a place where a service is provided
ex: The hotel has excellent leisure facilities.
飯店有很棒的休閒設施。

en: a. remaining loyal to a person or cause; accurate and true to the original; believing in a particular religion; n. loyal followers of a religion or a leader
ex: The dog was faithful to its owner until the end.
那隻狗到最後都對主人忠實。

en: n. the state of being known by many people because of success or achievements; (old use) a rumor or report
ex: The young singer rose to fame overnight.
那位年輕歌手一夕成名。

en: a. extremely good or wonderful; very strange or unusual; extremely great; existing only in the imagination
ex: We had a fantastic time at the beach.
我們在海邊玩得非常愉快。

en: a. causing death; having serious bad effects; decided by fate and unable to be avoided; (of a mistake) very serious
ex: The accident was fatal for three passengers.
這場意外造成三名乘客死亡。

en: n. a machine that sends and receives copies of documents using a telephone line; a copy of a document sent by this machine; vt. to send a document by fax
ex: Please fax the contract to our office by noon.
請在中午前把合約傳真到我們辦公室。

en: n. a boat that carries people and vehicles across a short stretch of water; the place where boats leave from; vt. to carry people or goods across water
ex: We took the ferry across the bay.
我們搭渡輪穿過海灣。

en: vt. to go to get something and bring it back; to be sold for a particular price; to attract someone; vi. to go and get something; n. a distance traveled; a ghost
ex: Can you fetch me a glass of water, please?
可以請你幫我拿一杯水嗎？

en: n. a place in the wall of a room where a fire can be lit; the area around it
ex: We sat by the fireplace and drank hot cocoa.
我們坐在壁爐旁喝熱可可。

en: a. able to speak or write a language easily and well; (of speech or writing) smooth and natural; able to do something easily and gracefully
ex: She is fluent in three languages.
她能流利說三種語言。

en: n. a mass of small bubbles on the surface of a liquid; a light, soft material used for packing or insulation; vi. to produce foam; vt. to make something produce foam
ex: The waves left white foam on the beach.
海浪在沙灘上留下白色泡沫。

en: vt. to order someone not to do something; to make something impossible or very difficult; to prevent something from happening
ex: Smoking is forbidden in this building.
這棟建築物內禁止吸菸。

en: n. a statement about what is likely to happen, especially about the weather; vt. to say what you think will happen in the future; to plan in advance
ex: The forecast says it will rain tomorrow.
天氣預報說明天會下雨。

en: n. the lowest part of a building that supports it; the basic idea or principle on which something is based; an organization that provides money for a particular purpose; the act of establishing something
ex: The house was built on a strong foundation.
這棟房子建在堅固的地基上。

en: a. easily broken or damaged; (of a person) weak and in poor health; (of a situation) likely to fall apart
ex: Please handle the fragile vase with care.
請小心輕放這個易碎的花瓶。

en: n. the number of times that something happens in a particular period; the rate at which a sound or radio wave vibrates; how often something happens
ex: The frequency of earthquakes has increased in this region.
這個地區的地震頻率增加了。

en: vi. to bring your eyebrows together to show anger, worry or concentration; to show disapproval; n. an expression on the face showing worry or disapproval; vt. to express something by frowning
ex: She frowned when she read the bad news.
她讀到壞消息時皺起了眉頭。

en: n. the feeling of being annoyed because you cannot do what you want; something that annoys you; the act of stopping someone from achieving something
ex: She felt frustration when her plan failed again.
她的計畫再度失敗時感到挫折。

en: vt. to do or achieve something that you hoped or promised to do; to do what is required; to make something happen; (fulfillment) a feeling of satisfaction after achieving something
ex: She worked hard to fulfill her dream of becoming a doctor.
她努力實現成為醫生的夢想。

en: a. relating to how something works or is used; practical and useful rather than decorative; (of a machine or system) working properly; (in medicine) relating to the way an organ works
ex: The kitchen is small but very functional.
廚房雖小但很實用。

en: a. forming the base or most important part of something; very important and basic; n. a basic idea, rule or principle; (plural) the most important parts of a subject
ex: There is a fundamental difference between the two systems.
這兩個系統之間有根本的差異。

en: n. a building or room where art is shown or sold; a long narrow room or passage; a raised floor in a theater or church; a collection of things such as pictures or photographs
ex: We visited an art gallery in the city center.
我們參觀了市中心的一間美術館。

en: vi. to look steadily at something for a long time, usually with surprise or interest; n. a long steady look at something; vt. to look at something for a long time
ex: She gazed out of the window at the falling snow.
她望著窗外飄落的雪。

en: n. a unit inside a cell that controls characteristics that are passed from parent to child
ex: She inherited the gene for blue eyes from her mother.
她從母親那裡遺傳了藍眼睛的基因。

en: n. all the people who were born at about the same time; the time between the birth of parents and the birth of their children; the process of producing something; a single stage of development of a product
ex: My generation grew up without the internet.
我這一代人是在沒有網路的環境中長大的。

en: n. the quality of being kind, especially in giving money or help; the willingness to give more than is usual or expected; the quality of being forgiving
ex: We thank you for your generosity in helping the school.
感謝你慷慨幫助學校。

en: n. a person who is unusually clever or skilled; a very great natural ability; the spirit of a place or a person
ex: Mozart was a musical genius even as a child.
莫札特從小就是音樂天才。
ph: 天才是百分之一的靈感

en: a. extremely large; like a giant in size; huge in amount or importance
ex: They built a gigantic statue in the center of the city.
他們在市中心建了一座巨大的雕像。

en: n. a quick or incomplete look at something; a short experience of something; vt. to see something for a very short time; vi. to shine faintly
ex: I caught a glimpse of her face in the crowd.
我在人群中瞥見了她的臉。

en: n. an object shaped like a ball; the Earth; a map of the Earth on a ball; a glass cover for a lamp; v. to form into a ball
ex: A globe sat on the teacher's desk.
老師的桌上放著一個地球儀。

en: a. having great beauty or splendor; deserving great honor or praise; very enjoyable and pleasant
ex: We enjoyed a glorious day of sunshine at the beach.
我們在海邊享受了陽光燦爛的一天。

en: a. kind, polite and pleasant to other people; showing mercy; (of a way of life) comfortable and elegant
ex: Thank you for your gracious hospitality.
感謝你親切的款待。
